features.title: Apple Watch companion app
features.desc: A focused wrist companion for logging intake. Shows today's active nutrients with goal-type-aware progress bars and a + button on each row to log one step increment. Reads from the same shared SwiftData store as the iPhone app via the existing App Group — no extra setup, data appears automatically.
features.icon: <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="6"/><polyline points="12 8 12 12 14 14"/>

features.title: Watch complications
features.desc: WidgetKit-based complications for the Watch face: circular ring gauge, corner count, and inline text showing "X / Y on target" at a glance. Refresh after every log tap.

improvements.title: Faster first launch on a brand-new install
improvements.desc: Skip the 3-second CloudKit sync wait when the app has never launched on this device before and there's no prior iCloud data to restore. Onboarding appears instantly.

fixes.title: Reminder suppression re-firing notifications
fixes.desc: Fixed dose reminders firing again later the same day after being suppressed by a logged intake.

fixes.title: History flame badges ignoring goal types
fixes.desc: Fixed the flame streak indicators on History days using minimum-only logic. They now correctly respect each nutrient's goal type (minimum / maximum / range), matching the rest of the app.

features.title: Nutrient goal types
features.desc: Each nutrient can now be configured as "At least" (minimum), "At most" (maximum), or "Between" (range). Progress bars, analytics charts, streaks, and widgets all adapt to the selected goal type.

features.title: Goal type picker in nutrient form
features.desc: Segmented control with plain-English labels, a dynamic caption explaining the behavior, and a live mini progress bar preview so you see the exact colors before saving.

features.title: Range target fields
features.desc: When "Between" is selected, Minimum and Maximum fields appear side by side for quick entry.
features.icon: <rect x="3" y="6" width="7" height="12" rx="2"/><rect x="14" y="6" width="7" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M10 12h4"/>

improvements.title: Gradual color transitions
improvements.desc: Progress bars and chart bars now blend colors smoothly: blue→green for minimum nutrients, orange→red for maximum, and yellow→red when exceeding limits — instead of abrupt color switches.

improvements.title: Visible overflow on progress bars
improvements.desc: Maximum and range progress bars scale the limit tick mark to 85% of the bar width, so exceeding the limit is immediately obvious as the fill extends past the mark.

improvements.title: Collapsed intake history
improvements.desc: Expanded nutrient cards on Today now show only the 5 most recent entries by default, with a "Show all" link when there are more. Keeps the screen manageable on heavy logging days.

features.title: Per-nutrient analytics
features.desc: Tap any nutrient in My Nutrients to see a dedicated analytics screen with three cards: a daily intake bar chart (7D/30D/90D), period stats (hit rate, daily average, target), and day-of-week patterns (4-week averages with strongest day highlighted).
features.icon: <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M7 15V11"/><path d="M12 15V7"/><path d="M17 15v-5"/>

features.title: Profile picture
features.desc: Set a profile photo from your library or camera in Edit Profile. Your photo appears in the navigation bar across all tabs.

improvements.title: Save dismisses profile sheet
improvements.desc: Tapping Save in Edit Profile now closes the sheet immediately instead of showing a toast.

improvements.title: Edit button removed from My Nutrients
improvements.desc: Tap now navigates to analytics; editing remains available via swipe-left and context menu.

fixes.title: Duplicate nutrient reminders
fixes.desc: Fixed multiple notifications firing at the same time for a single reminder. Notification IDs now use the stable nutrient UUID instead of SwiftData's internal identifier, which could change across app launches and CloudKit syncs. Orphaned notifications from the old format are cleaned up automatically.

features.title: Expandable nutrient cards
features.desc: Tap any nutrient card on the Today screen to see a chronological breakdown of every intake logged for that nutrient today, including times, amounts, and notes.
features.icon: <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M7 8h10"/><path d="M7 12h6"/><path d="M9 16l3 3 3-3"/>

features.title: Reminders during nutrient creation
features.desc: Set dose reminders while creating a new nutrient, making the feature more discoverable. Notification permission is requested gracefully on first use.

improvements.title: Log button in expanded cards
improvements.desc: A quick-access + button at the bottom of expanded nutrient cards opens the exact amount sheet, encouraging logging directly from the breakdown view.
improvements.icon: <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M12 10v8"/><path d="M8 14h8"/>

improvements.title: Nutrient row summary in My Nutrients
improvements.desc: Each nutrient now shows daily target, reminder count, and step increment as three icon-labeled columns for better scannability and reminder discoverability. Nutrient notes are displayed inline next to the name.

improvements.title: Keyboard dismiss after onboarding nutrient
improvements.desc: The keyboard now hides after adding a nutrient during onboarding so the Get Started button is visible.

improvements.title: Empty group delete confirmation
improvements.desc: Deleting a group with no nutrients now shows a simpler confirmation without mentioning "0 nutrients will be moved".

features.title: iCloud sync
features.desc: Your data now syncs automatically across all your Apple devices via CloudKit. On by default, no setup required. Works offline — sync is additive, never a dependency.

features.title: New-device restore
features.desc: Reinstalling the app or setting up a new device restores all your data from iCloud automatically, skipping onboarding.

features.title: Sync banners
features.desc: One-time banners on the Today screen inform you when data is restored from iCloud or when sync is active on a fresh install.

features.title: iCloud Sync settings
features.desc: New Settings → iCloud Sync page showing sync status, a toggle to enable/disable sync, and a "Delete iCloud Data" option to permanently remove your data from iCloud while keeping local data intact.

improvements.title: In-app review prompt
improvements.desc: Automatically invites engaged users to rate the app at natural high points (streak milestones or 30 total intake logs) using Apple's native review dialog. No custom UI — once per version, 90-day cooldown.

improvements.title: CloudKit-compatible models
improvements.desc: All data models updated with property-level defaults and optional relationships for CloudKit compatibility.

improvements.title: Singleton deduplication
improvements.desc: Automatic deduplication of system records (General group, user profile, preferences) when syncing across multiple devices.

improvements.title: Live sync refresh
improvements.desc: Today screen automatically refreshes when CloudKit imports remote data, so changes from other devices appear without switching tabs.

improvements.title: Immediate persistence
improvements.desc: Intake records are explicitly saved to disk after every +/− tap, ensuring data survives app termination and reaches CloudKit faster.

fixes.title: Data preserved on CloudKit upgrade
fixes.desc: Existing local data is backed up before the first CloudKit-enabled launch and migrated into the new store if needed. Prevents data loss when updating from a pre-sync build.

fixes.title: Nutrient reordering on tap
fixes.desc: Fixed nutrients shuffling position after tapping +/− by updating totals in-place instead of re-fetching from SwiftData.

fixes.title: Stable nutrient sort
fixes.desc: Added tiebreaker to nutrient sorting so items with the same group sort order maintain a consistent position.

fixes.title: Notification permission reset after reinstall
fixes.desc: Fixed stale notification flags synced from iCloud causing the daily reminder toggle and banner to show incorrect state after reinstalling the app or setting up a new device.

features.title: Streaks & consistency tracking
features.desc: Track your daily completion streak across Today, History, and widgets. A streak day counts when all active nutrients met their targets, respecting exclusions and creation dates.

features.title: Streak summary in History
features.desc: Current streak and best streak shown in a summary card at the top of the History tab, with flame indicators on individual streak days.

features.title: Streak in widgets
features.desc: Small and medium home screen widgets now show your current streak count when active.
features.icon: <rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/>

features.title: Streaks settings page
features.desc: Dedicated Settings → Streaks page with a "Track streaks" toggle (on by default). Designed for future streak-related settings.

improvements.title: Tighter Settings layout
improvements.desc: Settings items grouped into fewer sections for a more compact, standard iOS look.

improvements.title: Hidden group headers when only General
improvements.desc: If no custom groups are defined, group headers are hidden on Today and My Nutrients for a cleaner, minimal look.

features.title: Home screen widgets
features.desc: Three sizes (small, medium, large) showing your daily nutrient progress with interactive + buttons to log directly from your home screen.
features.icon: <rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/>

features.title: Lock screen widgets
features.desc: Circular ring gauge and inline text widget showing your daily completion count at a glance — no unlock needed.

features.title: Shared data via App Groups
features.desc: Widgets read from the same SwiftData store as the main app via a shared container. Existing data migrates automatically on first launch.

improvements.title: Instant widget refresh
improvements.desc: Widgets update immediately after logging (via + button or in-app) and on every app foreground.

improvements.title: Date in navigation bar
improvements.desc: The Today screen now shows the current date (e.g. "Tuesday, 24 March") instead of a static title.

improvements.title: Completion count in group headers
improvements.desc: Collapsed and expanded group headers now show how many nutrients have hit their daily target (e.g. "2 / 5").

improvements.title: Inline group creation
improvements.desc: Create a new group directly from the nutrient form's group picker — no need to leave the screen.

improvements.title: Haptic feedback
improvements.desc: Subtle haptic feedback on +/− buttons for a more tactile logging experience.

improvements.title: Tighter group spacing
improvements.desc: Reduced section spacing between groups on the Today screen for a more compact layout.

improvements.title: Notes in reminders
improvements.desc: Nutrient reminders now include the nutrient's note as the notification body when one is set.

fixes.title: Reminders not firing
fixes.desc: Fixed nutrient reminders not triggering due to an async race condition in notification scheduling.

fixes.title: Comma decimal separator
fixes.desc: Fixed decimal input not working on devices using comma separators (e.g. entering "0,5" as a step value).

fixes.title: Number display precision
fixes.desc: Fixed values truncating to 1 decimal place — now shows up to 2 (e.g. "0.25").

features.title: Nutrient grouping
features.desc: Organise nutrients into named groups (e.g. Vitamins, Supplements). Groups are collapsible on both Today and My Nutrients, with an aggregate progress bar when collapsed.

features.title: Manage Groups
features.desc: New screen in Settings for creating, renaming, reordering, and deleting groups. A default "General" group is created automatically.

features.title: Move to Group
features.desc: Long-press any nutrient on Today or My Nutrients to quickly move it to a different group.

features.title: Group picker on create
features.desc: When adding a nutrient, a group picker lets you assign it to a group right away (defaults to General).

features.title: Per-nutrient dose reminders
features.desc: Set multiple daily reminders per nutrient (e.g. Aspirin at 9 AM, noon, and 8 PM). Smart suppression cancels upcoming reminders after you log intake.

features.title: Nutrient notes
features.desc: Optional free-form text field on each nutrient. Shown as a muted line below the nutrient name on the Today card.

features.title: Monthly section headers in History
features.desc: Day entries grouped under sticky month headers (e.g. "March, 2026") for easier navigation.

features.title: Swipe actions on Today
features.desc: Swipe right to add an exact amount, swipe left to edit a nutrient — right from the Today screen.

features.title: Custom amount notes
features.desc: Add an optional note when logging an exact amount. Notes are visible in the History intake detail.

features.title: Settings page
features.desc: New Settings screen with a Notifications toggle and About section. Access it from the profile menu.

features.title: Daily check-in reminder
features.desc: Opt-in local notification at noon if you haven't logged anything that day. Smart scheduling adjusts based on your activity.

features.title: Notification prompt banner
features.desc: Dismissible banner on the Today screen prompting you to enable the daily reminder. Shown once after onboarding.

fixes.title: Migration crash fix
fixes.desc: Fixed a SwiftData migration crash when the notification banner preference was added without a property-level default.

fixes.title: Notification permission prompt
fixes.desc: Fixed the permission prompt being swallowed when triggered from within a sheet.

fixes.title: Stale reminder list
fixes.desc: Fixed reminder list and count not refreshing after adding a new reminder.

fixes.title: "Add Reminder" button visibility
fixes.desc: Fixed the button being hidden behind the date picker by switching to a compact picker layout.

features.title: Onboarding
features.desc: A two-step setup flow — personal info first, then your first nutrient. The app is never empty on day one.

features.title: User-defined nutrients
features.desc: No preset list. Create any nutrient with a custom name, unit, step size, and daily target.

features.title: Today, My Nutrients & History tabs
features.desc: The core three-tab layout. Log intake with +/−, manage your list, and browse every past day.

features.title: Fully offline & private
features.desc: All data stored locally via SwiftData. No accounts, no servers, no telemetry — ever.
